$knextQuarantines.mechanism: Fixture assumes Vercel. next.config.js is `process.env.VERCEL ? {} : { cacheHandler: './cache-handler.js', cacheMaxMemorySize: 0 }`; the harness does not set VERCEL, so the fixture's probe handler is used, and its get() always returns null (set() is a no-op). The isNextDeploy branch then asserts two back-to-back renders return the same random values, which needs a real cache. '/foo/bar?key=value&added=1&extra=2' : '/foo/bar?key=value'`, with upstream's note that deployed proxies put rewrite-added query values into the URL passed to the function while locally they are only in req.query. knext serves through Next's own standalone server, whose NextNodeServer.runApi forwards the resolved query and params but deliberately keeps req.url as the original browser-visible URL (vercel/next.js#94905). knext returns url '/foo/bar?key=value' and query {key:'value', added:'1', extra:'2', slug:['bar']}, which matches the expected query exactly; only the deploy-branch req.url expectation differs. WEBPACK CELLS ONLY in effect: at v16.3.5 the file's setup has `skipDeployment: isAdapterTest && isTurbopackTest` (upstream FIXME), so the turbopack cells never run it and this lane-blind file exclusion changes only the two webpack cells. File level because §c.1's per-case suites entries are flakey-only and this failure is deterministic; the cost is the file's other 56 passing webpack cases, which stop running as ongoing coverage. Upstream's mirrored suites.failed entry for this file ('Middleware Rewrite should handle catch-all rewrite correctly') is subsumed by the exclusion and removed; restore it when this entry retires.

$knextExclusions.rationale: knext targets the Node/Bun standalone server (output:'standalone'); it has no edge (V8-isolate) runtime. The Edge Runtime is architecturally out of scope — knext matches Vercel's compute layer, not its global edge (CLAUDE.md §8 bucket 1). compat-matrix row: Edge Runtime ❌.

Edge Middleware runs in the Edge Runtime, which knext does not provide. knext supports the (deprecated) Node middleware/proxy convention only; edge-middleware deploy tests assume the isolate runtime. Upstream-gated + architectural (CLAUDE.md §8). compat-matrix row: Edge Middleware ❌.
Partial Prerendering (PPR) is not adapter-standardizable yet (CLAUDE.md §6 Tier C, upstream-gated); knext does not implement the PPR resume/stream contract. compat-matrix row: PPR ❌.

Cache Components ('use cache' / cacheLife) are an evolving upstream API not yet stabilized for adapters (CLAUDE.md §6 Tier C). knext's Redis cache-handler does not implement the Cache Components protocol. compat-matrix row: Cache Components ❌.
